subject.title: fix(memory-core): adjust dreaming promotion thresholds + add memory_get recall tracking

question: Should enabled dreaming installations without explicit `minScore` overrides receive the lower 0.55 promotion defaults, despite the resulting increase in automatic writes to existing `MEMORY.md` files?
rationale: This is a persistent behavior-policy change for an opt-in but already shipped feature; source review can establish the compatibility impact but cannot choose the intended promotion-quality tradeoff.

options.title: Keep current defaults by default
options.body: Repair `memory_get` tracking while leaving existing threshold defaults unchanged, with operators able to opt into lower thresholds through the existing dreaming configuration.

options.title: Adopt lower defaults with upgrade proof
options.body: Approve the 0.55 defaults only with explicit fresh-install and upgrade tests demonstrating the intended promotion volume and no cross-agent state contamination.

recommendation.title: Keep current defaults by default
recommendation.body: Repair `memory_get` tracking while leaving existing threshold defaults unchanged, with operators able to opt into lower thresholds through the existing dreaming configuration.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the weighted threshold and recall-tracking contract that the requested default-policy change would revise.
